english.meaning: the general measure word for people and things (一個人); with no number before it, works like 'a'
english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken Cantonese pattern for an unspecified singular person or thing, with the appropriate classifier replacing 個 when needed.

exampleSentences.english: I want to buy a popsicle.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 go3 syut3 gou1
